newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Sept 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Sept 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Secretary-General of Gulf Arab Chambers of Commerce says a proposed Middle East bank will harm Arab states, benefits Israel.
- Arab experts to discuss ways of fighting economic crimes.
- An Irish trade team to visit Saudi Arabia this week.
- Saudi health minister signs three contracts worth more than 219 million riyals with local firms to operate and maintain hospitals.
- Shares of al-Rajhi for Banking and Investment drop 19 riyals to 872 riyals each on rumours that it will double its paid-in capital by grant free shares to shareholders.
- Saudi Arabian Fertiliser Company's sales rose to 928.96 million riyals in 1995, up 238.32 million riyals on 1994.
- Saudi nationals constitute 80.1 percent of the workforce in the Post, Telephone and Telegraph Ministry.
